label: Bugfix
description: Repro-first fix: capture the wrong behaviour in a failing test, fix it, prove the repro passes, sweep for the same defect class; hand off the PR (no auto-merge). If you decide to use sub agents, always set openai-oauth/gpt-5.5 · effort: low.
when_to_use: Use when existing observable behaviour is WRONG and must be corrected. Do NOT use for new/changed behaviour ('feature'), zero-behaviour-change restructures ('refactor'), or when only diagnosis is wanted ('investigate').

guards.message: Complete the failing reproduction and the proven fix before committing. A fix without a red-first repro test is not done.
This workflow does NOT merge — verify the pre-push gate genuinely passed (never --no-verify), report the PR as ready, and stop.

steps.label: Reproduce the bug in a failing test (RED)
steps.guidance: Read the issue (`gh issue view <N> --json title,body,comments`) and reproduce the reported behaviour BEFORE touching any production code. Capture it as the narrowest failing automated test that asserts the CORRECT behaviour and fails now for the reported reason (show the failure output). If you cannot reproduce it, stop and report that instead of guessing at a fix. Done when the failing test and its failure output are recorded.

steps.label: Fix the defect (GREEN)
steps.guidance: Make the smallest correct fix — mechanism over bandaid: fix at the depth where the invariant belongs, not just the reported symptom's call site. No drive-by refactors. Done when the repro test passes and no other targeted tests broke.

steps.label: Same-defect-class sweep
steps.guidance: Grep for the same defect pattern elsewhere in the codebase (same misuse, same wrong assumption, copy-pasted siblings). Fix in-scope instances the same way with the same test discipline, or file an issue for out-of-scope ones — never silently ignore a found sibling. Done when the sweep result (clean, fixed, or filed) is recorded.

steps.label: Commit and push through the full gate
steps.guidance: Branch if on master, stage only intended files, commit with a message linking the issue. `git push` in the FOREGROUND and WAIT for the fast pre-push gate to exit; fix failures and push again; never --no-verify. Done when the push exited with the gate passing.

steps.label: Open the PR
steps.guidance: Open the PR against master with `gh pr create`: title naming the bug, body with the root cause, the repro evidence, and the sweep result. Confirm OPEN state and head SHA via `gh pr view <n> --json number,headRefOid,state`. Done when PR number and head SHA are confirmed.

steps.label: Request authoritative CI and report the PR (no merge)
steps.guidance: After all review comments are resolved and the current head is final, run `gh pr edit <n> --add-label merge-requested`. This requests authoritative CI for that exact revision. Wait with `gh pr checks <n> --watch`; if another commit is pushed, the label is removed automatically and must be reapplied only when ready. Do NOT merge or set auto-merge; report the PR and CI result for human merge.
